column1: # Saudi Arabia, Umm al-Qura (KACST): the calendar's own prayer-times API, GetPrayerByYear at each
# point with zone 3 (profiles-tested.md, data-umm-al-qura; 12 places, 13,146 place-days 2024–2030).
# Each file is one API point, checked there (lat and lon are the query's). The API prints no end of
# eating: the fast begins at its Fajr (F+E). Standard Asr.
# Split, forward in time and across the country: fit on the nine files that end by 2027 (Madinah,
# Jeddah, Dammam and Abha 2025–2027; Haql, Al Kharkhir, At Tuwal, Taif and Tabuk 2026); held out,
# Makkah and Riyadh 2024–2030 and Turaif (the far north, 31.7° N) 2024 and 2026–2030, whose 2024 has
# no lag dates and whose 2028–2030 lie beyond every fitted day.
